WebMind AI empowers enterprises, researchers, and developers to transform any public website into an intelligent, high-precision AI knowledge assistant. By combining asynchronous multi-page crawling, semantic DOM extraction, dense vector embeddings, and hybrid BM25 search, WebMind delivers sub-second answers grounded strictly in source documentation.

title: WebMind AI - Neural Web Scraping & RAG Intelligence Engine

text:
Source Document: WebMind AI - Neural Web Scraping & RAG Intelligence Engine > Section: Autonomous Crawling Architecture

The WebMind scraping engine traverses internal links recursively using an asynchronous queue. It respects robots.txt directives, normalizes canonical URLs, bypasses navigational clutter, and extracts clean markdown hierarchy without cookies, banners, or ads.

title: WebMind AI - Neural Web Scraping & RAG Intelligence Engine
section_heading: Hybrid Vector Retrieval and Grounded RAG
context_header: Source Document: WebMind AI - Neural Web Scraping & RAG Intelligence Engine > Section: Hybrid Vector Retrieval and Grounded RAG
text:
Source Document: WebMind AI - Neural Web Scraping & RAG Intelligence Engine > Section: Hybrid Vector Retrieval and Grounded RAG

Retrieved documents are divided into hierarchical semantic chunks with breadcrumb headers. Queries execute across both dense vector cosine similarity and sparse BM25 lexical keyword rankings. The resulting context is injected into a strictly grounded system prompt that prevents hallucinations and generates verified citations.
